interpretation: Whole-run masked maxima include WAI/idle and ROM intervals; the independent receive/transfer oracle enforces the actual byte deadline.
IRQ-routing duration can include two RX services after the bounded recheck.
Touched-stack watermarks are observed lower bounds; native stack/domain guards and reserved interrupt headroom also pass.
Idle/emulation evidence predates the payload-only second RX opportunity; individual source hashes are retained.
This does not qualify a production console worker, eight simultaneous console Tasks, windows or physical hardware.
